data.name: Veiled Whispers
data.detailed_description:
Your voice is a beacon. Your silence is a shield.

Dive into a high-stakes Extraction PvE Horror experience where the environment is as lethal as the entities within it. In a world that shifts and breathes, you must complete your objectives and reach the extraction point before the shadows close in. But beware: the creatures in this world don't just see you—they are listening to your every word.

Key Features:

  • Adaptive Voice-Detection Technology: This is not just a game mechanic; it’s a death sentence. The entities hunting you react in real-time to your actual microphone input. Whisper to coordinate with your team, or hold your breath to stay hidden. In this world, a single scream can trigger a relentless hunt.

  • Hardcore Co-op or Brutal Solo Play: Designed as a deep Cooperative Survival Horror, the game demands perfect teamwork and communication. While you can brave the darkness alone for greater rewards, the difficulty scales—making Solo play a true test of skill, patience, and nerves.

  • A Shifting, Ever-Changing World: No two incursions are the same. The world evolves and reconfigures itself, changing paths, hazards, and objective locations. You must adapt your strategy on the fly as the landscape shifts around you, ensuring that no map can ever be truly "memorized."

  • Objective-Based Extraction Gameplay: You aren't just here to survive; you have a job to do. Complete high-risk missions—gathering data, recovering artifacts, or sabotaging occult sites.

  • Tactical Sound Management: Beyond your voice, every action has an acoustic footprint. Running through brush, breaking glass, or interacting with heavy machinery creates noise profiles that attract different types of threats. Balance efficiency with stealth to survive the extraction.

The mission is simple. The execution is silent. Can you make it out alive?

content_descriptors.notes:
Warning: Mature Content

Our game contains intense violence and adult themes that may not be suitable for all players. These include:

Violence: Graphic depictions of violence, blood, and disturbing scenes.
Adult Themes: Psychological horror elements that may induce fear, tension, and discomfort.
Sensitive Themes: The game may explore psychological distress, isolation, and other emotional challenges.
These elements are integral to the gameplay and narrative to provide an authentic horror experience. Players should be aware of the intense nature of the game. Our game is intended for mature audiences.
